tips.text: Hawaii uses a bumper sticker instead of a windshield sticker. Its color and shape have stayed the same since 2013.
On top of the standard Texas sticker, Dallas sometimes puts a small T sticker on cars that look abandoned or are about to be towed. It sits at the top center of the windshield.
The Louisiana sticker is a perfect square with the state outline on it. It is white or a faded yellow.
Maine sticker always has a chunk missing from it. The sticker color changes annually.
The number is placed in center above bar code. The sticker is placed on passenger's side. Color changes annually.

A big white bar sits above the word 'Missouri', and the month is marked with a black dot. The sticker color changes annually. Missouri stickers are not a common sight on Street View: only cars with 150k+ miles or older than 10 years need one.

The New Hampshire sticker is a white rectangle with a thick colorful outline. The sticker is placed on the driver's side. The sticker color changes annually. Since February 2026 stickers are no longer required.
New Orleans City in Louisiana has a unique circular sticker. The sticker color changes annually.
New York uses 2 stickers on windshield. The bigger one is in light colors (white, pale yellow, light grey) while smaller one changes color annually.
Pennsylvania uses 2 stickers on windshield with visibly big font for numbers. The sticker's color changes annually.
The Rhode Island sticker has a big white patch in the bottom left corner. The sticker is placed on the passenger's side. The sticker color changes annually.
Texas sticker has a blue outline over white rectangle. Color of the sticker is consistent every year.
Vermont sticker has a qr code on the right side. The sticker color changes annually.
Virginia's sticker has a big number on the left side while the second number on the right is a lot smaller. The sticker color changes annually.

This one has a blue top and blue bottom bars that don't reach the edges. This pattern has been consistent for many years. Relatively few cars are registered in D.C., so this sticker is not commonly seen
This one has a big colorful rectangle attached to small white one. The sticker color changes every 2 years.
